Create one complete square illustration of Shelly, a cute friendly bear-inspired mascot for a product-safety app called SafeShelf. One character only, no written text.
The BODY ITSELF IS A ROUNDED SHIELD: flat rounded top, broad rounded shoulders, tapering sides and a soft point at the bottom. The shield body silhouette must remain obvious. It is glossy bright blue with gradient sky blue #5aa9ff at top to deep blue #0262c8 at bottom, and a soft white highlight on upper left. No separate handheld shield.
On the front is a large rounded white visor face panel, two big simple glossy dark-navy oval eyes, and one small friendly smile. Integrate the following unmistakable bear identifying features: two small round bear ears beside the antenna. This must read as a bear version of the same shield-bodied guardian, with the main body retaining its shield shape rather than an ordinary animal torso.
A single curved blue antenna rises from top center and ends in one glowing round light. Keep antenna separate and readable alongside any ears.
Short stubby blue arms with round white mitten hands, two small dark-navy oval feet. Both arms, both mittens, both feet visible. Thick dark-navy #001123 outlines. Clean polished vector-style illustration, flat shading with subtle gradients and restrained glossy highlights, soft ground drop shadow. Calm, trustworthy, caring guardian personality, adorable compact proportions.
Show full character, upright, centered with comfortable margins on a clean pale ice-blue #edf6ff background. Consistent illustration style and palette. No props, lettering, watermark, frames, scenery, extra characters, weapons or photorealism. Generate approximately 1536 × 1536.
